title: Support ClassDefs in external diagrams
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

This removes the hardcoded check on supported types, and instead checks if the diagram renderer actually exports the necessary function. 

Resolves #4818

Published as [10.5.0-alpha.1](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mermaid/v/10.5.0-alpha.1)
## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

This is better than exposing the array for the external diagram to modify. 

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] :computer: have added necessary unit/e2e tests.
- [x] :notebook: have added documentation. Make sure [`MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION`](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/packages/mermaid/src/docs/community/development.md#3-update-documentation) is used for all new features.
- [x] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch
author: sidharthv96

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: This is the main logic change in the PR. Rest are mostly type changes.

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
Would it be better to add a `?? {}`; to the this line, so it more closely matches the previous code.

That way, we won't need to add `| undefined` to the type.

```ts
  const diagramClassDefs = diag.renderer.getClasses?.(text, diag) ?? {};
```

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
That was what I did first, but the actual place where the value is used already expects `undefined | null`. So there is no need to assign here. 

https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/e75af86ef25c3af7ee54ba04f39d38be5c7beea1/packages/mermaid/src/mermaidAPI.ts#L175-L178

comments.author: aloisklink
sidharthv96
comments.body:
Done. 
But it didn't change any docs automatically.

IMO, we should deprecate and mark mermaidAPI itself as internal.

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
> But it didn't change any docs automatically.

Huh, weird. I swear we've used `@alpha`/`@experimental` before, and it worked to not export any documentation to the website, but maybe I'm just imaging things.

:shrug: Oh well

> IMO, we should deprecate and mark mermaidAPI itself as internal.

I'm not sure if I full agree with this, since marking something as `@internal` when it can be used by users doesn't seem right to me, but `@deprecate`-ing some of the functions does make sense!

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body: Is it worth adding in your PR description that you've published this PR as https://www.npmjs.com/package/mermaid/v/10.5.0-alpha.1 for testing purposes?

comments.author: Yokozuna59
comments.body: I think `getClasses` is more like `styles` rather than `renderer`.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
`getClasses` is already present in the renderers of multiple diagrams. I'm only adding the types here. 
 
Moving it out can be a separate PR when necessary.

comments.author: knsv
comments.body: I think we should groom several issues to widen support for classDef to all relevant diagrams. The groomed issues should outline what needs to be don and how to doit to make it easier for contributors to get started.
